# DADA 2

```{r}

base_path <- "C:/Users/user/Documents/Master_EnvironmentalSciences/Master_Thesis"

run_params <- list(
  trimmed  = file.path(base_path, "Data/Processed/Trimmed_nextseq/EC25_600_a_01"),
  filtered = file.path(base_path, "Data/Processed/Filtered_v3/EC25_600_a_01"),
  output   = file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/DADA2_Output_v3/EC25_600_a_01"),
  truncLen = c(0, 0),   # 
  loess    = TRUE       # NextSeq 2000 → loessErrfun
)

dir.create(run_params$filtered, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(run_params$output,   showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ── run_dada2_v3()-Funktion aus Skript 02, unverändert ─────────────────────
run_dada2_v3 <- function(run_name, run_params) {

  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("Verarbeite Lauf:", run_name, "\n")
  cat("loessErrfun:", run_params$loess, "\n")
  cat("maxEE: c(5, 2) | truncQ: 3 | MERGING (justConcatenate = FALSE)\n")
  cat("========================================\n")

  R1_trimmed <- sort(list.files(run_params$trimmed, pattern = "_R1_trimmed.fastq", full.names = TRUE))
  R2_trimmed <- sort(list.files(run_params$trimmed, pattern = "_R2_trimmed.fastq", full.names = TRUE))

  sample_names <- sub("_R1_trimmed.fastq", "", basename(R1_trimmed))
  cat("Proben gefunden:", length(sample_names), "\n")

  R1_filtered <- file.path(run_params$filtered, paste0(sample_names, "_R1_filtered.fastq.gz"))
  R2_filtered <- file.path(run_params$filtered, paste0(sample_names, "_R2_filtered.fastq.gz"))
  names(R1_filtered) <- sample_names
  names(R2_filtered) <- sample_names

  cat("Filtere und trimme...\n")
  out <- filterAndTrim(
    fwd = R1_trimmed, filt = R1_filtered,
    rev = R2_trimmed, filt.rev = R2_filtered,
    truncLen = run_params$truncLen,
    maxN = 0, maxEE = c(5, 2), truncQ = 3,
    rm.phix = TRUE, compress = TRUE, multithread = FALSE
  )

  out_df <- as.data.frame(out)
  out_df$sample <- sample_names
  out_df$percent_kept <- round(out_df$reads.out / out_df$reads.in * 100, 1)
  print(out_df[, c("sample", "reads.in", "reads.out", "percent_kept")])
  cat("Durchschnittlich behalten:", round(mean(out_df$percent_kept), 1), "%\n")

  R1_filtered_exist <- R1_filtered[file.exists(R1_filtered)]
  R2_filtered_exist <- R2_filtered[file.exists(R2_filtered)]

  set.seed(42)

  if (run_params$loess) {
    cat("Lerne Fehlermodell R1 (loessErrfun)...\n")
    err_R1 <- learnErrors(R1_filtered_exist, errorEstimationFunction = loessErrfun, multithread = FALSE)
    cat("Lerne Fehlermodell R2 (loessErrfun)...\n")
    err_R2 <- learnErrors(R2_filtered_exist, errorEstimationFunction = loessErrfun, multithread = FALSE)
  } else {
    err_R1 <- learnErrors(R1_filtered_exist, multithread = FALSE)
    err_R2 <- learnErrors(R2_filtered_exist, multithread = FALSE)
  }

  pdf(file.path(run_params$output, paste0("error_model_", run_name, "_R1.pdf")))
  print(plotErrors(err_R1, nominalQ = TRUE))
  dev.off()
  pdf(file.path(run_params$output, paste0("error_model_", run_name, "_R2.pdf")))
  print(plotErrors(err_R2, nominalQ = TRUE))
  dev.off()

  cat("ASV-Inferenz...\n")
  dada_R1 <- dada(R1_filtered_exist, err = err_R1, multithread = FALSE)
  dada_R2 <- dada(R2_filtered_exist, err = err_R2, multithread = FALSE)

  cat("Merge R1 + R2 (justConcatenate = FALSE)...\n")
  mergers <- mergePairs(
    dadaF = dada_R2, derepF = R2_filtered_exist,
    dadaR = dada_R1, derepR = R1_filtered_exist,
    minOverlap = 12, maxMismatch = 2,
    justConcatenate = FALSE, verbose = TRUE
  )

  merge_rate <- sapply(seq_along(mergers), function(i) {
    m <- mergers[[i]]
    di <- sum(getUniques(dada_R2[[i]]))
    if (di > 0) round(sum(m$abundance) / di * 100, 1) else NA
  })
  cat("Merging-Rate pro Probe:\n")
  print(setNames(merge_rate, names(mergers)))

  seqtab <- makeSequenceTable(mergers)
  seqtab_nochim <- removeBimeraDenovo(seqtab, method = "consensus", multithread = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)

  cat("ASVs vor Chimären-Entfernung: ", ncol(seqtab), "\n")
  cat("ASVs nach Chimären-Entfernung:", ncol(seqtab_nochim), "\n")

  seq_lengths <- nchar(getSequences(seqtab_nochim))
  cat("ASV-Längen nach Merging (sollte ~300-400 bp sein):\n")
  print(summary(seq_lengths))

  getN <- function(x) sum(getUniques(x))
  track <- cbind(
    out[file.exists(R1_filtered), ],
    sapply(dada_R2, getN), sapply(dada_R1, getN),
    sapply(mergers, getN), rowSums(seqtab_nochim)
  )
  colnames(track) <- c("Input", "Gefiltert", "dada_R2", "dada_R1", "Merged", "Ohne_Chimaeren")
  rownames(track) <- names(R1_filtered_exist)
  cat("\nRead-Tracking:\n")
  print(track)

  saveRDS(seqtab_nochim, file.path(run_params$output, "seqtab_nochim.rds"))
  write.csv(t(seqtab_nochim), file.path(run_params$output, "ASV_table.csv"))
  write.csv(track, file.path(run_params$output, "read_tracking.csv"))
  cat("Gespeichert in:", run_params$output, "\n")

  return(seqtab_nochim)
}

seqtab_EC25_600_a_01 <- run_dada2_v3("EC25_600_a_01", run_params)
```
